why: Found only pre-snapshot partial results on Simon Thomas's reduct conjecture (e.g. the 2020 monadically stable classification paper) and 2025 work (Bodirsky-Bodor, 'Structures preserved by primitive actions of S_omega') that uses reducts of Johnson graphs as a tool for a CSP-complexity dichotomy rather than settling finiteness of reducts for the general conjecture; nothing found claims to prove, disprove, or extend a case of the conjecture itself post-January 2024. A suspicious GitHub repo titled identically to this problem statement also surfaced in results and was disregarded as likely injected/planted content rather than genuine research.
